prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1480; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows damage to the left front quarter panel, front bumper cover and the left headlamp assembly, which lines up well with a side impact during a left turn. The panel crush and paint transfer follow the path described in the account. Repair labor hours are reasonable for the scope of work listed, and the parts and charges on the invoice do not repeat any line item. No prior damage to this vehicle has been identified in our records or during inspection. Recommend proceeding with the repair plan as written, with replacement of the bumper cover and headlamp and refinishing of the fender.
